Brief guide that can help along some youtube videos if you are having a lot of trouble. You need: The game in .3ds, Pk3ds and Packhacks. 1- Create a folder named Randomizer. 2- Copy and paste the game inside. 3- Create a subfolder (inside randomizer)named Pk3ds and extract pk3ds inside. 4- Create another subfolder (inside randomizer) named Packhacks and extract packhacks inside. 5- Create another subfolder (inside randomizer) and name it New (this one is only where you will randomize stuff in and is most of the time empty). 6- Install packhacks. 7- Copy the game again and paste it inside packhacks (you will have 3 .exe files and the game.3ds). 8- Open the filemodifier (1 of the .exe) and decompile the .3ds file. (This is done by typing on the prompt 'd' then typing the file name and confirming with 'y'. 9- Copy everything inside packhacks and paste on new folder. 10- Go to pk3ds and open the .exe. 11 - Select the entire new folder and start randomizing. 12- Copy Extracted Rom (I cant remember the correct name / Will edit when I turn on my computer) abd paste it inside packhacks again (It will say that there are a lot of stuff that wants to replace so do it). 13- Open packhacks .exe again and and rebuild the file using the 'r' option. 14- When ita rebuile you will have a new .3ds with the name filename_edited.3ds (file name is the name of your file). 15- Rename the file and put it on citra and test it. 16- Delete everything inside new and use the cleantool inside packhacks to clean the folder. Ps: You dont need to delete everything inside new because you can just keep randomizing the same file there and just keep pasting the extracted rom inside packhacks and rebuilding it again.
